$description: Brutalist demo — ADR-022 shape/density overlay exemplar (#128, epic #124). Proves a tenant can be "sharp + dense" — role.radius pinned to 0 (density-invariant) and semantic.space.surface.padding tightened at rest, tightened further under [data-density="compact"] via the Compact figma-variables mode (R9). Storybook/Chromatic exemplar only — no deployment, no legal entity.

radius.$description: Brutalist demo: zero corner radius system-wide — sharp edges are the brand identity, density-invariant (no Compact mode).

padding.$description: Brutalist demo: tightened surface padding baseline (16px, scale.sm; was 24px, scale.md). Tightens further to 8px (scale.xs) under [data-density="compact"] via the Compact mode below (ADR-022 R9). Was semantic.space.component.padding before hds#206.
